form.title: Section 1061 Worksheet B: Owner Taxpayer Reporting of Recharacterization Amount

lines.caption: API 1-Year Distributive Share Amount from Worksheet A, line 4, which is attached to Schedule K-1.
API 1-Year Disposition Amount from Table 1, line 4.
1-Year Gain Amount Add lines 1 and 2. If the sum of line 1 plus line 2 is zero or less, enter zero on line 3 and skip to line 8.
API 3-Year Distributive Share Amount from Worksheet A, line 7, which is attached to the Schedule K-1.
API 3-Year Disposition Amount from Table 2, line 4.
3-Year Gain Amount Add lines 4 and 5. If the sum of line 4 plus line 5 is zero or less, enter zero.
Recharacterization Amount (treat as short-term capital gain) Subtract line 6 from line 3. If zero or less, enter zero.
Section 1061(d) Recharacterization Amount (as determined in Regulations section 1.1061-5(c)).
Section 1061 Adjustment to Form 8949 Add lines 7 and 8.

form.notes: Publication 541's owner-taxpayer worksheet. Its inputs are the Section 1061 Worksheet A a partnership attaches to the K-1 (box 20 code AM); line 9 is entered on Form 8949 Part I as proceeds and Part II as basis, moving long-term gain to short-term without changing the total.
